rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ 'Cross product results in a scalar' ✅ Cross product (vector product) *always* results in a vector, which is perpendicular to the plane of the two operand vectors.  ·  ❌ 'Cross product order doesn't matter' ✅ The cross product is *anti-commutative*: A × B = -(B × A). Swapping the order reverses the direction.
